description: This file contains the implementation of PPP protocol setup and teardown procedures for OpenWrt. It includes functions for configuring PPP over serial, PPPoE, PPPoA, and PPTP, with functions for initial configuration, setup, and teardown, as well as utility functions for handling IP addresses and exit codes.

methods.name: ppp_select_ipaddr
methods.description: Selects an IP address from a list of subnets based on the specified masking rules.

methods.name: ppp_exitcode_tostring
methods.description: Converts PPP exit codes into human-readable string descriptions.

methods.name: ppp_generic_setup
methods.description: Configures and starts a PPP interface with provided settings.

methods.name: ppp_generic_teardown
methods.description: Teardown a PPP interface and handle error reporting.
